bio.text: William Colton was elected to the New York State Assembly in November 1996 and represents the 47th Assembly District, which includes Bensonhurst, Gravesend, Bath Beach, Dyker Heights and Midwood in Brooklyn.

He is a lifelong resident of the district, holds a B.A. from St. John's University (1968), an M.S. from Brooklyn College and a J.D. from St. John's School of Law (1978), and was admitted to the New York bar in 1979.
He worked as a public school teacher for eleven years, according to the same biography.
